# Public live fixtures

Reduced from anonymous Endolla GELFS and Spirii AFIR Spain exports observed on
2026-10-20. Exact source URLs are recorded in `scripts/source_transport.py`.
These fixtures keep the original wrappers, identity references and transition
and publication timestamps. They retain two sites per feed. Spirii tariff,
helpdesk and operating-hours subtrees are removed. Tests vary copies to exercise
unknown values, conflicts, country filtering and failures without network access.

Endolla: Ajuntament de Barcelona / Endolla, CC BY 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), reduced and normalized for tests.
Spirii: Spirii and the actual operator named in each static site; public AFIR
status reuse approved by the owner. No named dataset licence is asserted.
